name: kalshi-mcp
description: Kalshi (event contracts) (trading): list_markets, get_ticker. Every tool maps to a documented endpoi

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Open, non-parlay markets (ticker, its event in `base`, binary/scalar in `type`; title and prices in raw). Pages by cursor only. Kalshi has no free-text search on this endpoint, so `query` is ignored.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Prices are the YES side in dollars (0-1); volume is contracts traded in 24h.
